name: math
statement: Mathematical notation as a language, in Unicode or a LaTeX subset: signatures (ℤ ℕ ℝ 𝔹), equations, piecewise cases, pattern equations, Σ and Π, where-bindings, domains and tests. It is a source (math lifts to the card IR, so to every codegen language) and a target (every IR function without machine state is emitted as equations; loops become recursive equations), and the target is witnessed by a round trip: lift(emit(f)) behaves like f.
